final: SELECT city_id, address_count, address_count / total_count AS proportion FROM (SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count FROM address GROUP BY city_id) AS city_counts CROSS JOIN (SELECT SUM(address_count) AS total_count FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS address_count FROM address GROUP BY city_id) AS grouped_counts) AS totals WHERE total_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY proportion DESC LIMIT 10
